value.source_quality_basis: Credible, byte-matched primary releases support many core claims, but the final source-conditioned recommendation has material numerical or applicability defects; FAIL does not reject the underlying sources.

material_defects.claim: The determinant-product margin is treated as the discriminating numerical stability test over general affine geotransforms.
material_defects.consequence: It measures cancellation in two determinant products, not general matrix conditioning. For A=diag(1,1e-12), r=1 but kappa_2=1e12; a Y perturbation of 1e-12 changes the inverse line by 1. Both proposed thresholds accept it. The tested degrees fixture is well-conditioned, but that does not validate r as a general conditioning measure. Unresolved threshold values do not fix the test form.

material_defects.claim: A raw determinant/adjugate with only an exact-zero guard is presented under a broad six-coefficient/any-CRS domain without finite/range/precision conditions.
material_defects.consequence: Binary64 diagonal scales of 1e-200 underflow the product to zero and incorrectly refuse a well-conditioned map; scales of 1e200 yield infinite determinant and NaN inverse for an exactly representable mathematical answer (0.5,0.5). Origin 1e16 with unit scale loses a 0.5-pixel X increment despite r=1. These are reviewer counterexamples, not failures observed in the supplied eight fixtures. Mathematical totality over real numbers does not supply floating-point representability.

material_defects.claim: Corner and center differ for every nonconstant map; only the zero block must be excluded from the distinctness check.
material_defects.consequence: For gt=[10,1,-1,20,1,-1], the nonconstant rank-1 map sends both (0,0) and (0.5,0.5) to (10,20), while (1,0) maps to (11,21). The check would reject a correct forward implementation on a valid singular input. Distinctness requires A*(0.5,0.5) != 0, not merely A != 0. Convention separation remains necessary even when coordinates coincide.

material_defects.claim: Transpose/determinant is proposed as an independent inverse control whenever columns are orthogonal.
material_defects.consequence: Orthogonality alone is insufficient. For diag(2,3), the inverse at world (1,1) is (1/2,1/3), while transpose/det gives (1/3,1/2). The implemented common-norm shortcut gives (1/2,3/4). Its check tests a row dot product and does not enforce equal norms; the current rotated fixture happens to be an equal-scale, positive-determinant rotation, so its three reported checks are correct. The generalized control can falsely reject a correct inverse.

supported_optional_findings.finding: All displayed forward and adjugate formulas have the correct coefficient order. All 35 supplied point constants verify in decimal rational arithmetic and within the stated tolerances for exact binary-input arithmetic. These are useful independent point checks, not merely successful roundtrips.
Out-of-extent points are legal affine-math inputs; raster containment belongs to caller policy. Real-number totality does not guarantee finite or distinguishable binary64 outputs.

One-based labels alone do not transpose an array. World-file coefficient order is a distinct mapping plus a half-pixel origin conversion. Output2 final states the mapping accurately; Output1 repeats the seed deterministic transposition claim and Output2 metadata still does.

GDAL 3.9.0 GDALInvGeoTransform has a nonzero-diagonal/no-rotation shortcut and otherwise rejects |det| <= 1e-10*max(|linear coefficients|)^2. This is distinct from mathematical invertibility and both proposed margin thresholds. The original frozen corpus does not contain that inverse body; the supplemental release file was read, never executed. This additional source is not used to claim candidates executed GDAL or to require an external oracle when independent derivation already suffices. GCP fit tolerance in the original corpus is a different, conditional 0.25-pixel residual policy.

Both retain unvalidated production tolerance values and unevaluated external GCP execution. The specific near-singular block has kappa_2=1,999,999 and inverse operator norm 1,000,000; Output1 reported Frobenius condition about 2e6, not an absolute universal inverse-amplification factor.

value.source_quality_basis: Credible, byte-matched primary releases support many core claims, but the final source-conditioned recommendation has material numerical or applicability defects; FAIL does not reject the underlying sources.

material_defects.claim: The determinant-product margin is treated as the discriminating numerical stability test over general affine geotransforms.
material_defects.consequence: It measures cancellation in two determinant products, not general matrix conditioning. For A=diag(1,1e-12), r=1 but kappa_2=1e12; a Y perturbation of 1e-12 changes the inverse line by 1. Both proposed thresholds accept it. The tested degrees fixture is well-conditioned, but that does not validate r as a general conditioning measure. Unresolved threshold values do not fix the test form.

material_defects.claim: A raw determinant/adjugate with only an exact-zero guard is presented under a broad six-coefficient/any-CRS domain without finite/range/precision conditions.
material_defects.consequence: Binary64 diagonal scales of 1e-200 underflow the product to zero and incorrectly refuse a well-conditioned map; scales of 1e200 yield infinite determinant and NaN inverse for an exactly representable mathematical answer (0.5,0.5). Origin 1e16 with unit scale loses a 0.5-pixel X increment despite r=1. These are reviewer counterexamples, not failures observed in the supplied eight fixtures. Mathematical totality over real numbers does not supply floating-point representability.

material_defects.claim: GDALGCPsToGeoTransform body lies outside the mapped frozen corpus, so fitting behavior is not witnessed there.
material_defects.consequence: The exact mapped gdal_misc.cpp contains the entire body at 2745-3022 and its contract at 2714-2741. Its exact-fit default is 0.25 pixel, with approximation configuration overrides, two-GCP no-rotation special case, range and rank guards. The negative source conclusion and omission of these applicability conditions are incorrect. No executed GDAL/GCP control is being demanded; the sandbox restriction and the decision to keep execution unevaluated are legitimate.

material_defects.claim: No expected value is computed at runtime, and every control discriminates against a separate oracle independence class.
material_defects.consequence: C2 computes the same expression as fwd at (0.5,0.5). W1 uses fwd again instead of the advertised frozen hp2/hp13 constants. W2 forward and W3 compare variants to fwd. C7 uses candidate-supplied col1/col2 for rotated/sheared without checking them against the fixture block. These are useful narrow checks, not independent witnesses of the full forward implementation. The frozen columns actually match, and 22 verified point constants plus W2 inverse and W4 hand-point checks supply real independent evidence; this is an overstatement of independence, not a blanket rejection of those controls.

material_defects.claim: The adjugate inverse matched all 22 hand oracle points where invertible.
material_defects.consequence: C3 executes 16 forward checks and only 6 inverse checks. Four of the 22 entries are forward checks on singular maps. The receipt truthfully reports 22 mixed point checks; final/report turn that into stronger inverse evidence. All 22 constants are correct, but the inverse coverage claim is inflated.

supported_optional_findings.finding: All displayed forward and adjugate formulas have the correct coefficient order. All 35 supplied point constants verify in decimal rational arithmetic and within the stated tolerances for exact binary-input arithmetic. These are useful independent point checks, not merely successful roundtrips.

GT2/GT4 transposition is invisible on the three north-up inputs; detected on rotated/sheared. Independent row reduction yields (11/5,2/5) for the wrong rotated inverse at (4,3), versus correct (1,2). W4 proves wrong-pair roundtrip success cannot validate correctness. Its logged maximum is a world-coordinate closure error, not pixel-recovery error.

Report M5 says the sheared margin denominator is 2.25 and ratio about 0.833. Exact values are 2.125 and 15/17=0.88235294. The final broad healthy range still contains the correct ratio; C9 executed only the near-singular margin, not this mistaken intermediate calculation.

One-based labels alone do not transpose an array. World-file coefficient order is a distinct mapping plus a half-pixel origin conversion. Output2 final states the mapping accurately; Output1 repeats the seed deterministic transposition claim and Output2 metadata still does.

GDAL 3.9.0 GDALInvGeoTransform has a nonzero-diagonal/no-rotation shortcut and otherwise rejects |det| <= 1e-10*max(|linear coefficients|)^2. This is distinct from mathematical invertibility and both proposed margin thresholds. The original frozen corpus does not contain that inverse body; the supplemental release file was read, never executed. This additional source is not used to claim candidates executed GDAL or to require an external oracle when independent derivation already suffices. GCP fit tolerance in the original corpus is a different, conditional 0.25-pixel residual policy.

Both retain unvalidated production tolerance values and unevaluated external GCP execution. The specific near-singular block has kappa_2=1,999,999 and inverse operator norm 1,000,000; Output1 reported Frobenius condition about 2e6, not an absolute universal inverse-amplification factor.

Report M5 calls scale-relative testing an amendment to the seed, but the common draft C4 already required a scale-relative test alongside the absolute tolerance at lines 69-71. The criticism of an absolute-only test is mathematically sound; its portrayal as correcting the seed is unsupported. The final states the correct limitation without requiring that strawman.

incorrect_rejections.note: W1-W4 selected wrong models are truly wrong and their intended discrepancies are independently confirmed. A proposed quality threshold may reject a mathematically invertible map; that policy choice alone is not graded an incorrect rejection.

final_preservation.details: Report dispositions survive the final, including correct core bindings and explicit nonexecution of GDAL. Material errors/overstatements listed above also survive; disclosure of uncertainty does not turn them into established findings.

all_six_obligation_dispositions.obligation: Bind coefficient order, coordinate units, and pixel-origin convention.
all_six_obligation_dispositions.assessment: Correct formula, zero-based GT mapping, CRS coordinate units and corner origin. Scale/rotation terms are CRS units per pixel if pixel units are retained. The deterministic one-based-to-transpose assertion is an ancillary overstatement, not a failure of the displayed coefficient binding.

all_six_obligation_dispositions.obligation: Separate pixel corners from centers.
all_six_obligation_dispositions.assessment: Source corner/center distinction and half-pixel shift are correct, and all tested displacements match. The universal nonconstant-map distinctness condition is false on singular maps.

all_six_obligation_dispositions.obligation: Address rotation/shear rather than assuming north-up.
all_six_obligation_dispositions.assessment: General off-diagonal terms retained. Rotated block has dot 0, equal squared norms 5, positive determinant 5; sheared block has column dot 1. General inverse-control condition is separately defective under O5.

all_six_obligation_dispositions.obligation: State invertibility and numerical tolerance conditions.
all_six_obligation_dispositions.assessment: Real-arithmetic det != 0 criterion and supplied singular refusals are correct. Proposed thresholds stay unresolved, but r is not a general conditioning test and finite/range/offset-error conditions are missing.

all_six_obligation_dispositions.obligation: Use independent derivation or trusted-operation controls, not only mutually paired forward/inverse functions.
all_six_obligation_dispositions.assessment: Ten forward and three inverse hand expectations independently verified by exact rationals and Gaussian elimination; the tested structured control is valid for this rotated fixture. Literal/matrix transcription and paired roundtrips remain narrow corroboration. Proposed orthogonal-block control is too broad. External GCP execution is accurately proposed, not performed.

all_six_obligation_dispositions.obligation: Preserve witnessed versus proposed checks and applicability.
all_six_obligation_dispositions.assessment: Preserves source/proposed/executed labels, unresolved production tolerances and no executed GDAL claim. Receipt counts and numeric diagnostics agree. Final carries forward erroneous generic distinctness/control/numerical domains.

supplement_value.source_quality_basis: Credible, byte-matched primary releases support many core claims, but the final source-conditioned recommendation has material numerical or applicability defects; FAIL does not reject the underlying sources.

material_defects.claim: The determinant-product margin is treated as the discriminating numerical stability test over general affine geotransforms.
material_defects.consequence: It measures cancellation in two determinant products, not general matrix conditioning. For A=diag(1,1e-12), r=1 but kappa_2=1e12; a Y perturbation of 1e-12 changes the inverse line by 1. Both proposed thresholds accept it. The tested degrees fixture is well-conditioned, but that does not validate r as a general conditioning measure. Unresolved threshold values do not fix the test form.

material_defects.claim: A raw determinant/adjugate with only an exact-zero guard is presented under a broad six-coefficient/any-CRS domain without finite/range/precision conditions.
material_defects.consequence: Binary64 diagonal scales of 1e-200 underflow the product to zero and incorrectly refuse a well-conditioned map; scales of 1e200 yield infinite determinant and NaN inverse for an exactly representable mathematical answer (0.5,0.5). Origin 1e16 with unit scale loses a 0.5-pixel X increment despite r=1. These are reviewer counterexamples, not failures observed in the supplied eight fixtures. Mathematical totality over real numbers does not supply floating-point representability.

material_defects.claim: Corner and center differ for every nonconstant map; only the zero block must be excluded from the distinctness check.
material_defects.consequence: For gt=[10,1,-1,20,1,-1], the nonconstant rank-1 map sends both (0,0) and (0.5,0.5) to (10,20), while (1,0) maps to (11,21). The check would reject a correct forward implementation on a valid singular input. Distinctness requires A*(0.5,0.5) != 0, not merely A != 0. Convention separation remains necessary even when coordinates coincide.

material_defects.claim: Transpose/determinant is proposed as an independent inverse control whenever columns are orthogonal.
material_defects.consequence: Orthogonality alone is insufficient. For diag(2,3), the inverse at world (1,1) is (1/2,1/3), while transpose/det gives (1/3,1/2). The implemented common-norm shortcut gives (1/2,3/4). Its check tests a row dot product and does not enforce equal norms; the current rotated fixture happens to be an equal-scale, positive-determinant rotation, so its three reported checks are correct. The generalized control can falsely reject a correct inverse.

supported_optional_findings.finding: All displayed forward and adjugate formulas have the correct coefficient order. All 35 supplied point constants verify in decimal rational arithmetic and within the stated tolerances for exact binary-input arithmetic. These are useful independent point checks, not merely successful roundtrips.
Out-of-extent points are legal affine-math inputs; raster containment belongs to caller policy. Real-number totality does not guarantee finite or distinguishable binary64 outputs.

One-based labels alone do not transpose an array. World-file coefficient order is a distinct mapping plus a half-pixel origin conversion. Output2 final states the mapping accurately; Output1 repeats the seed deterministic transposition claim and Output2 metadata still does.

GDAL 3.9.0 GDALInvGeoTransform has a nonzero-diagonal/no-rotation shortcut and otherwise rejects |det| <= 1e-10*max(|linear coefficients|)^2. This is distinct from mathematical invertibility and both proposed margin thresholds. The original frozen corpus does not contain that inverse body; the supplemental release file was read, never executed. This additional source is not used to claim candidates executed GDAL or to require an external oracle when independent derivation already suffices. GCP fit tolerance in the original corpus is a different, conditional 0.25-pixel residual policy.

Both retain unvalidated production tolerance values and unevaluated external GCP execution. The specific near-singular block has kappa_2=1,999,999 and inverse operator norm 1,000,000; Output1 reported Frobenius condition about 2e6, not an absolute universal inverse-amplification factor.

incorrect_rejections.note: All supplied correct point controls are correct. These false-rejection risks are bounded counterexamples under the declared domain, not alleged observed rejections of the original eight fixtures.

supplement_value.source_quality_basis: Credible, byte-matched primary releases support many core claims, but the final source-conditioned recommendation has material numerical or applicability defects; FAIL does not reject the underlying sources.

material_defects.claim: The determinant-product margin is treated as the discriminating numerical stability test over general affine geotransforms.
material_defects.consequence: It measures cancellation in two determinant products, not general matrix conditioning. For A=diag(1,1e-12), r=1 but kappa_2=1e12; a Y perturbation of 1e-12 changes the inverse line by 1. Both proposed thresholds accept it. The tested degrees fixture is well-conditioned, but that does not validate r as a general conditioning measure. Unresolved threshold values do not fix the test form.

material_defects.claim: A raw determinant/adjugate with only an exact-zero guard is presented under a broad six-coefficient/any-CRS domain without finite/range/precision conditions.
material_defects.consequence: Binary64 diagonal scales of 1e-200 underflow the product to zero and incorrectly refuse a well-conditioned map; scales of 1e200 yield infinite determinant and NaN inverse for an exactly representable mathematical answer (0.5,0.5). Origin 1e16 with unit scale loses a 0.5-pixel X increment despite r=1. These are reviewer counterexamples, not failures observed in the supplied eight fixtures. Mathematical totality over real numbers does not supply floating-point representability.

material_defects.claim: GDALGCPsToGeoTransform body lies outside the mapped frozen corpus, so fitting behavior is not witnessed there.
material_defects.consequence: The exact mapped gdal_misc.cpp contains the entire body at 2745-3022 and its contract at 2714-2741. Its exact-fit default is 0.25 pixel, with approximation configuration overrides, two-GCP no-rotation special case, range and rank guards. The negative source conclusion and omission of these applicability conditions are incorrect. No executed GDAL/GCP control is being demanded; the sandbox restriction and the decision to keep execution unevaluated are legitimate.

material_defects.claim: No expected value is computed at runtime, and every control discriminates against a separate oracle independence class.
material_defects.consequence: C2 computes the same expression as fwd at (0.5,0.5). W1 uses fwd again instead of the advertised frozen hp2/hp13 constants. W2 forward and W3 compare variants to fwd. C7 uses candidate-supplied col1/col2 for rotated/sheared without checking them against the fixture block. These are useful narrow checks, not independent witnesses of the full forward implementation. The frozen columns actually match, and 22 verified point constants plus W2 inverse and W4 hand-point checks supply real independent evidence; this is an overstatement of independence, not a blanket rejection of those controls.

material_defects.claim: The adjugate inverse matched all 22 hand oracle points where invertible.
material_defects.consequence: C3 executes 16 forward checks and only 6 inverse checks. Four of the 22 entries are forward checks on singular maps. The receipt truthfully reports 22 mixed point checks; final/report turn that into stronger inverse evidence. All 22 constants are correct, but the inverse coverage claim is inflated.

supported_optional_findings.finding: All displayed forward and adjugate formulas have the correct coefficient order. All 35 supplied point constants verify in decimal rational arithmetic and within the stated tolerances for exact binary-input arithmetic. These are useful independent point checks, not merely successful roundtrips.

GT2/GT4 transposition is invisible on the three north-up inputs; detected on rotated/sheared. Independent row reduction yields (11/5,2/5) for the wrong rotated inverse at (4,3), versus correct (1,2). W4 proves wrong-pair roundtrip success cannot validate correctness. Its logged maximum is a world-coordinate closure error, not pixel-recovery error.

Report M5 says the sheared margin denominator is 2.25 and ratio about 0.833. Exact values are 2.125 and 15/17=0.88235294. The final broad healthy range still contains the correct ratio; C9 executed only the near-singular margin, not this mistaken intermediate calculation.

One-based labels alone do not transpose an array. World-file coefficient order is a distinct mapping plus a half-pixel origin conversion. Output2 final states the mapping accurately; Output1 repeats the seed deterministic transposition claim and Output2 metadata still does.

GDAL 3.9.0 GDALInvGeoTransform has a nonzero-diagonal/no-rotation shortcut and otherwise rejects |det| <= 1e-10*max(|linear coefficients|)^2. This is distinct from mathematical invertibility and both proposed margin thresholds. The original frozen corpus does not contain that inverse body; the supplemental release file was read, never executed. This additional source is not used to claim candidates executed GDAL or to require an external oracle when independent derivation already suffices. GCP fit tolerance in the original corpus is a different, conditional 0.25-pixel residual policy.

Both retain unvalidated production tolerance values and unevaluated external GCP execution. The specific near-singular block has kappa_2=1,999,999 and inverse operator norm 1,000,000; Output1 reported Frobenius condition about 2e6, not an absolute universal inverse-amplification factor.

Report M5 calls scale-relative testing an amendment to the seed, but the common draft C4 already required a scale-relative test alongside the absolute tolerance at lines 69-71. The criticism of an absolute-only test is mathematically sound; its portrayal as correcting the seed is unsupported. The final states the correct limitation without requiring that strawman.

incorrect_rejections.note: W1-W4 selected wrong models are truly wrong and their intended discrepancies are independently confirmed. A proposed quality threshold may reject a mathematically invertible map; that policy choice alone is not graded an incorrect rejection.
